##### empty path (double space)
REQ: b'GET  HTTP/1.1\r\nHost: x\r\n\r\n'
EOF_BY_SERVER: True
RAW(0): b''

##### request line with 2 tokens
REQ: b'GET HTTP/1.1\r\n\r\n'
CONNERR: ConnectionRefusedError(111, 'Connection refused')

##### request line with 1 token
REQ: b'GET\r\n\r\n'
CONNERR: ConnectionRefusedError(111, 'Connection refused')

##### empty request line
REQ: b'\r\n\r\n'
CONNERR: ConnectionRefusedError(111, 'Connection refused')

##### garbage single token
REQ: b'GARBAGE\r\n\r\n'
CONNERR: ConnectionRefusedError(111, 'Connection refused')

##### no version (HTTP/0.9 style)
REQ: b'GET /index.html\r\n\r\n'
CONNERR: ConnectionRefusedError(111, 'Connection refused')

##### bogus version
REQ: b'GET /index.html BOGUS/9.9\r\n\r\n'
CONNERR: ConnectionRefusedError(111, 'Connection refused')

##### bogus method
REQ: b'BOGUSMETHOD /index.html HTTP/1.1\r\n\r\n'
CONNERR: ConnectionRefusedError(111, 'Connection refused')

##### LF-only line endings
REQ: b'GET /index.html HTTP/1.1\nHost: x\n\n'
CONNERR: ConnectionRefusedError(111, 'Connection refused')

##### very long path 8000
REQ: b'GET  HTTP/1.1\r\n\r\n'
CONNERR: ConnectionRefusedError(111, 'Connection refused')

##### very long path 100000
REQ: b'GET  HTTP/1.1\r\n\r\n'
CONNERR: ConnectionRefusedError(111, 'Connection refused')

##### query string
REQ: b'GET /index.html?v=1 HTTP/1.1\r\n\r\n'
CONNERR: ConnectionRefusedError(111, 'Connection refused')

##### fragment in request line
REQ: b'GET /index.html#frag HTTP/1.1\r\n\r\n'
CONNERR: ConnectionRefusedError(111, 'Connection refused')

##### absolute-form URI
REQ: b'GET http://127.0.0.1:18111/index.html HTTP/1.1\r\n\r\n'
CONNERR: ConnectionRefusedError(111, 'Connection refused')

##### asterisk-form
REQ: b'GET * HTTP/1.1\r\n\r\n'
CONNERR: ConnectionRefusedError(111, 'Connection refused')

##### OPTIONS asterisk
REQ: b'OPTIONS * HTTP/1.1\r\n\r\n'
CONNERR: ConnectionRefusedError(111, 'Connection refused')

##### encoded slash %2F
REQ: b'GET /%2Findex.html HTTP/1.1\r\n\r\n'
CONNERR: ConnectionRefusedError(111, 'Connection refused')

##### bad percent escape
REQ: b'GET /%zz HTTP/1.1\r\n\r\n'
CONNERR: ConnectionRefusedError(111, 'Connection refused')

##### non-utf8 percent escape
REQ: b'GET /%FF%FE HTTP/1.1\r\n\r\n'
CONNERR: ConnectionRefusedError(111, 'Connection refused')

##### dup headers
REQ: b'GET /index.html HTTP/1.1\r\nHost: x\r\nX-Dup: a\r\nX-Dup: b\r\n\r\n'
CONNERR: ConnectionRefusedError(111, 'Connection refused')

##### pipelined 2 requests
REQ: b'GET /zero.txt HTTP/1.1\r\nHost: x\r\n\r\nGET /empty.txt HTTP/1.1\r\nHost: x\r\n\r\n'
CONNERR: ConnectionRefusedError(111, 'Connection refused')

##### HTTP/1.0 + keep-alive
REQ: b'GET /index.html HTTP/1.0\r\nConnection: keep-alive\r\n\r\n'
CONNERR: ConnectionRefusedError(111, 'Connection refused')
